forecast-period.text: A cold front clears to the east Wednesday evening. An upper level feature builds over the Pastoral districts, lingering on Thursday before clearing to the northeast on Friday. Weak troughs clip the southeast in a broad westerly flow on Thursday and Friday, as a ridge of high pressure approaches South Australia from the west. The high centre is expected to linger over the state on the weekend.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Showers, tending to rain at times, and possible thunderstorms about parts of the Pastoral and northern Flinders districts. Isolated showers about the Southern Agricultural Area, most likely about windward coasts and ranges. Maximum temperatures below average, tending above average in the far north and near average about the Agricultural Area. West to northwesterly winds in the south, tending east to southeasterly in the north. Winds shifting south to southeasterly from the west during the day.

Early morning fog about parts of the Agricultural Areas, West Coast and adjacent North West Pastoral districts. Possible early morning frost about the Flinders and Mid North districts. Showers, tending to rain at times, about the north, clearing during the evening. Isolated light showers about the Agricultural Areas. Maximum temperatures below average. South to southeasterly winds, tending westerly in the southeast.

Early morning fog about the Agricultural Area and adjacent West Coast and Pastoral districts. Possible early morning frost about the Flinders and Mid North districts. Isolated light showers developing about the far northwest during the day and continuing about the Southern Agricultural Area, most likely about windward coasts and ranges, clearing by the evening. Maximum temperatures below average, tending near average about the Southern Agricultural Area. West to southwesterly winds in the southeast, tending northeast to southeasterly winds elsewhere. Winds easing to light and variable in the southeast during the evening.

text.p: Early morning fog on and east of the ranges and in the southeast. Possible early morning frost about the southeast and Flinders district. Showers, tending to rain, about western parts and extending into central parts throughout the day. Thunderstorms possible about the northern and western parts of the state. Maximum temperatures below average, tending near average about the Southern Agricultural Area. North to northeasterly winds, shifting west to southwesterly from the west in the evening.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Sunday: Broadly less than 2mm, increasing to 5 to 15mm about the Pastoral districts, and isolated parts of the southern coastal fringes, the Mount Lofty Ranges, and the South East districts. Further falls between 15 to 25mm about central parts of the Pastoral districts are likely. Isolated falls of 20 to 40mm are also possible with thunderstorms.
